note: D0 baseline refresh, measured (not hand-edited): scripts/run_all_tests.ps1 on 2026-11-07, log at reports/ty/_baseline_measured2_20261107.txt -> AGGREGATE GREEN. 6617 backend passed, 0 failed, 117 skipped, 125 subtests, 869-884 s; identity by name 6736 ids vs 6453 baseline (+283 new, -0 removed, 0 failing). Counts below are a floor (passed >= baseline), not an equality, because the autonomy loop adds tests every cycle. The previous run of the same script was RED with 17 then 12 failures: all were one defect - test_egress_guard.py installed the egress guard and its autouse teardown re-applied the monkeypatched urlopen fake after pytest had restored the real one, so every later network test received a bare BytesIO. Fixed in that fixture (it now restores the transport it saw before the test) and each of the 12 passed immediately.
